subject: Similarities
author: Segaswirl
body:
Midnight Club 3 and Burnout 3 were my favourite racing games on the old Xbox, they both had a great sense of speed... but they were both almost totally different racing experiences thanks to Midnight Club 3 being free roaming. They were both amazing games but in their own way.

Midnight Club 3: http://uk.youtube.com/watch?v=1L8b4tIw_vw&feature=channel_page

Burnout 3: http://uk.youtube.com/watch?v=nWe--ouO_CM

Now that Burnout has decided to become a free roaming racing/driving game, you can't really say that there isn't any similarities between Paradise and MCLA. The main difference only really being that Midnight Club LA is really just a very nice upgrade of the old games... and to be honest, I wouldn't have it any other way. I think even the older games in the series (like 2 and 3) make Paradise look daft.

I'm all for developers trying something new with their games and not churning out the same drivel every year, but Midnight Club has kept the same gameplay elements from the older games while managing to change things up enough for each game in the series to stand out on itheir own. I mean... Midnight Club 2 (which is still a good game, even though it was one of the first racing games on Live) didn't even have licensed cars, that was one of the improvements in MC3.

Most of the reviews for MCLA have all said the same thing... "MCLA is nothing new, but what it does do... it does it well" and that really is enough for most people aswell as long time fans of the series. Paradise didn't need to be made (IMO), you get a lot of people saying how it's not Burnout  (I've even said it myself) and you can kinda see their point... It is Burnout, it's just gone in a direction it didn't need to go in.
